closingKeywordReason: Both guards named in #1473 (resolveInsideRoot, resolveCliPath) are fixed with a refusal-outcome regression test each.
assumptions: A third containment check of the same shape, deriveModules in ts/src/core/domain-scanner.ts (relative() + startsWith('..')), is the same bug and was fixed in the same PR with its own regression test.

Inlined the segment check in each guard (matching findExistingTests) rather than importing judomaster's isWithin: isWithin treats the root itself as outside (rel === '' refused), which resolveInsideRoot must accept, and importing analysis/judomaster into core/mcp-server would add a cross-layer edge. No new module, so no entropy.entryPoints change.

mcp-server.ts and skill-registry.ts were already over the 300-LOC per-file threshold; this adds 4 and 2 lines. check-perf identity set is unchanged (197 before and after); growth is magnitude-only and advisory per #869.
